[[Old Ascalon/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name = Old Ascalon | game link type 0 = explorable | game link num 0 = 033 }} Before [[the Searing]], [[Old Ascalon]] was a beautiful, pastoral land of rolling hills and farms. Now, nothing remains but a barren, blasted wasteland infested with monsters. == Getting there == New [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]] campaign characters will enter this area automatically upon completion of the [[Ascalon Academy]] [[mission]]. Travel north to find the exit into [[Ascalon City]]. [[Guild Wars Factions|Factions]] and [[Guild Wars Nightfall|Nightfall]] characters will need to travel back from [[Lion's Arch]] to [[Ascalon City]]. them fight it out can save a couple dozen kills. == Trivia == * There are the remains of what appears to be a wagon at the location that [[Hamish|Hamish the Merchant]] occupied in [[pre-Searing]]. * Much of the explorable area of Old Ascalon was [[Green Hills County]] and [[Lakeside County]] before the Searing. The entrance to Ascalon City is different from its pre-Searing location, and some of this area used to be inside Ascalon City before the Searing. * The [[Resurrection Shrine]] just outside of the City is facing a different direction than it was before the Searing. * There is a cave in the Southeast corner of the map that contains a small, deserted Charr jail. Before the Searing, this cave was the [[Devourer Cave]]. * During the [[E3 for Everyone]] beta event, this area was called the ''Ascalon Wilds''. The Ascalon Wilds had a vastly different appearance from Old Ascalon, having more canyons and blocky buildings like the missions.[https://blackfalcongames.net/?p=402 Guild Wars: Memories and Screenshots, Part 1: Introduction and E3 for Everyone, May 2004] ==References== {{Explorable areas in Ascalon}} [[de:Alt-Ascalon]]
